notes.title: Announcing Bus Simulator 27: Greetings from Felicia Bay!
notes.content: [previewyoutube="MR1913Q0uSk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Hello Bus Drivers,[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Greetings from Felicia Bay![/b][/p][p]Today, we’re happy to announce the development of [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2397320/Bus_Simulator_27/"]Bus Simulator 27[/url][/b], the next official installment in the series. Developed by Polish studio [url="https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Simteract"]Simteract[/url], renowned for their experience with premium simulation games, this entry will take you to a delightful summer on the Iberian Peninsula – introducing never-seen-before gameplay possibilities, frequently requested features, and the most advanced entry in the history of the franchise.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2397320/Bus_Simulator_27/"][/dynamiclink][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/3efe81bed38e3170be3147aadad1f32f25caa32b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/6024744bb556b95c88c1d7bc52bfda4709d18725.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/593fed8f02a6cd4d026b7e7c97ee76c7a53a3e51.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][b]Bus Simulator 27 will offer the most comprehensive bus fleet ever:[/b] With new, officially licensed brands and models, as well as iconic buses from previous entries, passengers waiting for a ride near the sunny beaches of Southern Europe can expect a truly unprecedented comfort![/p][p][b]Thanks to the power of Unreal Engine 5[/b], you can also look forward to a major technical leap that will set a new standard for the series going forward. Whether you're behind the wheel, walking the streets or riding as a passenger, the city with all its distinct districts, busy streets, and impressive landmarks is yours to discover – either as a solo entrepreneur or with friends in 4-player co-operative mode.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/b4fe5507f52ccbc35634b9cf67041615620e0882.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/2879cb3b15a6f819c4db8a0e70410ba101f6ec36.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/43eb28fafaaf2e470392fb846767bf5a52bfbf8a.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]Bus Simulator 27 will be released for PC, PlayStation 5 & Xbox Series X|S with more details to be announced in the future![/p][p]Stay tuned for more information about all officially licensed buses, manufacturers, and exciting new features to be revealed later this year.[/p][p][/p][h3]Your Bus Simulator Team[/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2397320/Bus_Simulator_27/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop – Welcome to the Official Map Extension!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=_qWkuMztE7E;full]https://youtu.be/_qWkuMztE7E[/previewyoutube]

Today we are happy to reveal a first look into the new areas of the [b]Official Map Extension[/b] for [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop[/b], which will be released in form of a [b]free DLC[/b] for all owners of the main game together with the huge [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop Update[/b] on May 16, 2023.

The [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Official Map Extension[/b] gives players access to a huge new area in the northern part of the North America inspired map "Angel Shores". In addition to three brand new city districts including numerous new streets, points of interest and bus stops, you can also expect brand new campaign missions which will lead you through the mountainous nature park with its idyllic lakes, forests and villages. And not to forget: For the first time there will also be deer crossings, so that caution is always advised while driving through the impressive landscapes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/7a070ad30e0eec230210df7721fa39f9aeafcd3b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Why nature and not more city stuff?[/h2]

As usual, the answer to this kinda question is more simple than we’d like it to be – we wanted to create a vibrant area that will be very different from the usual urban vibe of Bus Simulator 21. The Map Extension is a sort of a natural breakaway, a resort, a retreat to mother nature. It’s a way for our players to go away from the buzzing city and have some piece of mind in a more “secluded” area. And we think that we nailed it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/fa50efec3a3638226c1e7f41c5683acabc87ce4e.png[/img]

[h2]Inspirations[/h2]
It's no secret that almost all areas in Bus Simulator 21 are in one way or another designed after real life places. Map Extension isn’t an outlier here as well. Let’s take our new landmark – the Geysers – as an example. Some people will clearly see a resemblance with the Old Faithful – an iconic geyser located in Yellowstone National Park in Wyoming – and they will be absolutely correct! 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/7VmgZP3/04-fixed-camera-morning-Trim.gif[/img]

The overall vibe we got from the Pacific Northwest – namely Oregon and Washington. These were our main references when we modelled and created the DLC. While we did want the Map Extension to be a new experience with different vibes, we didn’t want it to be too separated from the main game as well, so it’s well connected to the existing locations. We can’t wait for you to take a nice scenic drive around it!

[h2]The Wildlife[/h2]
Although we did talk about the new drive event already, we want to mention the animals again. It’s one of the team’s most favourite things about the DLC and A LOT of work went into actually making them work as intended.

Of course, we had things like this one happening at first…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/c742ef0f1ad69063fa79ab8f732eb8260f143195.png[/img]

Some of you already noticed that we were adding a new region to the game and we had to take certain precautions. When we put colliders – blockers – so you don’t wander into the new area by chance, the thing that you can see above happened, because animals reacted to the collision points as well. Gladly this bug never made it to the production builds.

We can’t wait for everyone to see the new animal drive event in action – we bet you’ll love it. New area holds many sights to witness, but the living nature, its vibe and ambience is something else to behold…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/da1e11ec47c0f26436e41051534f65b6ce7fc922.png[/img]

The [b]free Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop – Official Map Extension[/b], the huge [b]Next Stop Update[/b], as well as dedicated versions for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S and the [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop – Gold Edition[/b] will become available on May 16, 2023!

[b]Your Bus Simulator Team[/b]

notes.title: Developer Blog #2: Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop – The new Career Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/daa26e99ec978d023ace4022ebadd4a7a1d04c6b.jpg[/img]

[b]Welcome back, Bus Drivers![/b]

Please welcome a brand-new game mode in Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop — [b]Career Mode[/b]! We had a lot of messages asking us to add a sandbox feature of sorts to the game. And we listened! That’s how two new game modes came into existence: Sandbox and Career Mode. While Sandbox is pretty much a classic 'infinite resources, infinite possibilities' type of mode, Career is different. Very different. 

Let’s talk about it. 

[b]What’s the fuss about?[/b]

The goal of the Career Mode is to build a company in a real economy – much like campaign mode. But everything you need is unlocked from the start and there are no missions, no story, no quests – only you, the city and the roads. The only limited resource is – money. So, when we say 'real economy', we mean it – Career Mode will have a more realistic route planning model and a new way of calculating your payday.

At the beginning, you'll only have enough money for one bus and some extra money for small expenses (fines). After that it’s free for all and your planning and money-making skills will be put to the test. Where and how to start? Which bus to get first? What routes will net the most money fast? These are the challenges and questions you need to find a solution for in Career Mode. 

[b]So it’s a hard mode?[/b]

Not at all! Career Mode isn’t really easier or harder than the normal campaign – it’s just different.

First and foremost, Career Mode is about a different economic system. To give you interesting choices and let you create an actual working economy, we’ve had to tweak a lot of things that were already present in the game. [i]Some[/i] of the changes were so good that they even made their way into the main game as well.

These were our design goals for the game mode: 
[olist]
[*] Length of your routes will become more important than before. 
[*] Demand-balanced routes that are focused on a certain peak-time will become much more interesting to play with. 
[*] More skillful and careful driving = better income. 
[*] Your bus model, manufacturer and its engine will matter a lot more now. 
[/olist]
So far, our closed playtests have shown amazing results and we can’t wait to release Career Mode for everyone! We are curious to see how you will adapt to the new economy system of the Career Mode. 

[b]But how do I manage all those new data points?[/b]

The [i]information[/i] about your balance, the income and outgoings, wages, expenses, and other things concerning the wealth of your company are crucial for successful planning. It should be [i]as transparent as possible[/i], which was the main goal of this change. Take a look at the updated Payday Screen: 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y26XH0S/payday1.gif[/img]

As you can see, the new UI holds much more information that affects your final paycheck. Notable additions are ticket sales, accidents, and insurance. We also have a much more detailed and transparent showing of what is earned by NPCs and by you. Pay attention to the new symbols and categories for drive events – they will represent 'the weight' on the given event and will be sorted by it. Higher drive event rating will give better results too, so hone your driving skills! 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/r531c52/Payday-Screen-Career-mode-09-Trim-Trim.gif[/img]

[b]Get involved![/b]

We spent a lot of time gathering reports from all over the internet: Steam reviews, Steam forums, Twitter, Discord and our in-game bug reporting tool. But we still like to hear from you! [url=https://stillalive.at/BS21FeedbackForm][b]Go to our online Feedback Tool[/b][/url] to send us what’s bothering you. We’re still listening!

[b]tl;dr[/b]
[olist]
[*] Career Mode will give everyone a brand new way to experience Bus Simulator 21
[*] Treat it as a something different, not something easier or harder than the campaign
[*] Optimized routes are of much more importance than before
[*] Large focus on payday changes: new income modifiers and data points 
[*] Classic sandbox mode is also included! 
[/olist]

Career mode will be a part of the free Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop update, launching May 16, 2023 on all platforms. 

[b][i]Your teams at stillalive studios and astragon Entertainment[/i][/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/976590/Bus_Simulator_21/

notes.title: Developer Blog #1: Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Dev Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/41987abcf0445b2157c5ed969647b0b0bb59a41f.png[/img]

[b]Hello Bus Drivers![/b]

We know that you’ve been waiting for more news on Bus Simulator 21. We now have some! Thank you for your continued support for us and the game over the past months! And we are excited to give you a peek on what’s next for Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop.

[b]Finally![/b]

In the past, our release and testing schedule didn’t allow us to do changes on a deep level. Before we could touch core systems, we already had to close everything up and go into the next testing phase. But over time, we could not make any more meaningful improvements without going deeper into core systems.

That’s why we decided to reserve a longer period of time without releases. This allowed us to make significant improvements to many of the areas you sent us feedback for and which we could not tackle due to the complexity and dependencies of all interconnected systems! To get more things done during that focused development, we also added more people to the development team. Now, we can’t wait to show you what’s coming.

[b]So, what’s coming?[/b]

We are working on a major update to Bus Simulator 21 – Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop – that will come to PC, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X, PS4, and PS5 on May 23,2023.

While we can't reveal everything today but shorten the time until release, we’ll keep you informed with video clips of our fixes and improvements 👀😄 Follow @BusSimGame on Social Media and join our [url=https://discord.gg/astragon]Discord[/url] to stay up to date.

The improvement process had multiple areas united under a common theme: Smooth Simulation. It solves the biggest annoyances you sent our way on Discord, reports, mails and tweets and makes the drive experience a lot more enjoyable and fluid. These are the areas we focused on:

[list]
[*][b]Pedestrians:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Pedestrians will be more environmentally aware: A lot less crossing the street in awkward places. Less walking into the bus.
[*] They now move faster to allow for fluid boarding and unboarding. Of course some ”unique cases” might occur from time to time but you’ll feel a big improvement overall!
[*] Also, when the bus is full, passengers walk away and don’t block your bus.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]NPC Buses[/b]
[list]
[*] Buses driven by NPCs will leave stations earlier if other buses or players want to use the same stop and thus move out of the way.
[*] Route planning of NPC buses has been improved so they should not get stuck in areas with lots of parked cars and allow for much smoother traffic overall and a lot less traffic jams.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Traffic[/b]
[list]
[*] We heard you! Too many traffic jams! Cars being weird. We were on it! We worked on smart overtaking of your bus and reduced waiting times on intersections and we significantly reduced traffic jams that piled up over time.
[*] Additionally, we fixed a number of traffic lights and added missing ones.
[*] For cases where a traffic jam still occurs and locks everything up, we added a “reset traffic button” that is accessible in the game’s menu.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Crashes[/b]
[list]
[*] Crashes are a hugely complex topic as every PC and console reacts differently depending on the state it’s in, drivers, which and how many apps are currently loaded, what the OS is doing in the background and much more, but we again eliminated many sources of crashes when loading save games, starting companies, starting sandbox games… Bus Simulator 21: Next Stop will be a much smoother experience.
[/list] 
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] We squeezed out milliseconds here and there that add up, including FPS improvements for base consoles and reduction of memory usage to avoid “out of memory” crashes.
[*] Of course we have a lot of performance updates and fixes for the PC version as well. 
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Input & Steering Wheels[/b]
[list]
[*] We’re aware steering wheels are a constant source of frustration. We’ve been investigating this for a long time and “Next Stop” includes lots of various changes and fixes for Steering Wheels. However, we were not able to reproduce all issues you reported no matter what systems, drivers, wheels we tried to get to the bottom of these mysteries. All in all, in our closed testing with players from our community, we’ve seen great results so we hope that most of the issues will be gone for good!
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list]
[*] We were working hard on various multiplayer fixes you reported, including connectivity and stability fixes.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Map[/b]
[list]
[*] There are a TON of fixes on the maps where we removed obstacles, moved bus stop signs back so you don’t bump into them when stopping close to the curb, moved many signs so they don’t intersect with each other anymore.
[*] And there’s also a very big map extension that will be coming with the update. More details very soon!
[/list]
[/list]
That’s not everything that we will be releasing with the update. Keep your eyes peeled for more news here soon. If you have any questions regarding the announcement – please ask them in the comments section!

[b]Get involved![/b]

We spent a lot of time gathering reports from all over the internet: Steam reviews, Steam forums, Twitter, Discord and our in-game bug reporting tool. But we still like to hear from you! Go to our online Feedback Tool to send us what’s bothering you! We’re still listening!

We’ve prepared a public roadmap where you can follow our endeavor. Make sure to save a bookmark!

[b]Thank you![/b]

Instead of having to unlock everything bit by bit by completing missions, players can choose from all bus stops and bus models right from the start of the game, so that there are no limits to how far they can build up their own bus company - as long as they manage their start-up capital well, set up and operate routes successfully, expand their bus fleet skillfully and thus work their way up to become a successful local public transport company!

Another highlight of the Next Stop update is the release of the big [b]official map extension as a free DLC[/b], which has been eagerly awaited by fans of the game. Players can look forward to accessing a huge new area in the north of the US map "Angel Shores". In addition to [b]numerous new campaign missions[/b], a completely new feature awaits them in the mountainous nature reserve with its [b]idyllic lakes, forests and villages: wild animals crossing![/b] So be careful when driving through the impressive landscapes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/1b6625db25d8710b792c2318bd4138c0598cf3c8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Gold Edition and Gold Upgrade combine the main game with all DLCs released so far[/h3]
Meanwhile, with [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop - Gold Edition[/b], new bus fans can look forward to the all-in-one package. The [b]Gold Edition[/b] will also become available on May 23, 2023, and includes not only [b]Bus Simulator 21[/b] but also all previously released paid DLCs for the game - including the [b]MAN Bus Pack[/b], the [b]IVECO BUS Bus Pack[/b], the [b]VDL Bus Pack[/b], the [b]USA Skin Pack[/b], the [b]Angel Shores Insider Skin Pack[/b], and the [b]Protect Nature Interior Pack[/b]. The huge [b]Bus Simulator 21 Next Stop[/b] update will be released on [b]May 23, 2023[/b]. We hope you are looking forward to it as much as we do!

[h2]Hello Bus Drivers![/h2]

We hope you're all having a great time playing [b]Bus Simulator 21[/b], especially over the last weekend - nothing better than chilling and vibing through Angel Shores.

Some of you have informed us about completely unexpected performance problems. [b]Great hardware, low FPS[/b] - while others with similar hardware combinations don't have any problems at all.

On a special Steam branch, we are introducing a performance feedback tool that collects details about how the game runs on your PC. Should you experience these aforementioned problems, we'd ask you for your participation to help us fix them!

[h2]What does the performance feedback tool do?[/h2]

The performance feedback functionality in Bus Simulator 21 is actually just a hidden key
combination to trigger [url=https://docs.unrealengine.com/4.27/en-US/TestingAndOptimization/PerformanceAndProfiling/ CSVProfiler/]Unreal’s CSV profiler[/url] running with the default settings. Currently, this
feature is limited to special builds on a beta branch, so it does not work in the public version of the
game.

The data collection is running for 600 frames after pressing the key combination and creates a CSV
file with timing and memory usage data for those frames. The timing information allows to
determine which unit of the game (GPU, game logic, rendering) is limiting performance on your
PC, and also gives a very rough overview of what part of the game’s logic is using how much CPU
time.

The file is written to your PC user’s save data folder, so you can review it before sending it to us by
mail. The option to review the data is also why the data has to be sent manually. In addition to writing an output file, the keybinding also enables an on-screen timing display – namely Unreal’s stat unit output, so you can create screenshots for feedback purposes with a quick hint of how long each unit takes per frame.

[h2]How do I get this feature?[/h2]

[b]The feature is currently disabled. We will inform you very soon should it be back, thanks for the patience![/b]

Once you select the beta version, Steam will start downloading it. The download should not be too
large, given that only the EXE file is different.

[h2]How do I record performance data?[/h2]

[b][h3]First step: Backup and reset your keybindings[/h3][/b]
Getting the performance feedback keybinding working will require a reset of your keybindings to
default values. Therefore you might want to make a backup of them before continuing.
The keybindings of Bus Simulator 21 are stored in this file:

[b]%localappdata%\BusSimulator21\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\Input.ini[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/f67bcef445d319cd2a22f530d518e6483e15151c.png[/img]

The easiest way to both reset your keybindings to defaults and to make a backup of them is to
simply move this file to another folder. Once you are done with the performance feedback data
gathering, you can simply put that file back to its original location. In case you do not want to make a backup, you can also reset the keybindings in-game, in the settings menu, under [i]Controls[/i].

[b][h3]How to trigger data reporting and enable the stat unit HUD[/h3][/b]
Once you have reset your keybindings, you can now simply press [b]CTRL+ALT+P[/b] to record 600
frames in a CSV file, and to enable the stat unit overlay. You can immediately see if the command worked, as the stat unit overlay is a rather prominent debug text drawn on the right side of the game window.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/ad179712956381def897cb25b63f0555f26ca084.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Where to find the recorded data[/h3][/b]
Every time you press CTRL+ALT+P a file with 600 frames of timing data gets written to:
[b]%localappdata%\BusSimulator21\Saved\Profiling\CSV[/b]

[h2]How to send us the data[/h2]

To gather performance feedback, we have a dedicated mail address at
bs21csv@stillalive-studios.com.

As the gathered data does not contain [i]any[/i] details about your 
computer beyond the game’s timings, we’d be grateful [b]if you included your system specifications
when sending CSV-Profiles and/or screenshots with stats enabled[/b].

[i]Please note that this mail address is only for gathering performance feedback using the CSV
profiling feature described above. We will [b]not[/b] reply to [b]any[/b] emails sent there.[/i]

Thank you so much for your help! Together, we'll iron out these nasty problems.
[b]Your Bus Simulator Team[/b]

notes.title: Bus Simulator 21 - Update #1 available for download!
notes.content:
We just released our first big update for Bus Simulator 21. The update includes fixes for the save games issue some players were experiencing on their PC, a fix for the “Take off” mission in Seaside Valley as well as numerous other fixes and game improvements. Here are the detailed patch notes:

[b]Bus Simulator 21 - Update #1 (PC)[/b]

[b]Critical Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Prevent writing empty save game files - this fixes the future loss of save games (Sadly, lost save games unfortunately can’t be restored)
[*]Restoring access to save games you’ve been locked out of (missing permission issue) - you should now have the permission to use these save games again
[*]Saving now creates a backup of the previous save state, which is loaded if the most recent save got corrupted.
[*]Fixed a potential crash during the Tutorial
[/list]

[b]Improvements & New Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the option to reset controls to default in the Controls Menu (This does not include the steering wheel settings)
[*]Improved the confusing bus selection with keyboard and mouse. Now you can just click and hold to accept your bus choice. (The other/old method for accepting still works. For controller nothing changed)
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]“Perfect stopping position” when Bus kneeling is on should now be more consistent (Before the kneeling of the bus often prevented this from happening)
[*]NPC drivers will now despawn when they cannot walk to their seat to prevent them from blocking the view in the bus cockpit
[*]Passengers no longer suddenly spawn in the bus if another player is driving the bus or bus is not on a route
[*]When taking over a bus from the depot, it no longer spawns with passengers and puts you directly into the driver seat
[*]Fixed a bug where the length and duration of a route was not calculated correctly
[*]District names are now only shown once per route
[/list]

[b]Multiplayer Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Player is now assigned the correct route when joining a convoy
[*]Joining a Convoy should no longer get the camera stuck on the previous bus
[*]Ambient assignments didn't show their reward text on clients, now they are shown for both server and client
[*]Locked Decals are now locked for everyone in a multiplayer session
[*]Driven buses, routes and drive events now also show up for clients on the payday screen in multiplayer
[*]Improved stability of the back part of bendy buses in multiplayer
[/list]

[b]UI Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed empty notification text when trying to activate cashier mode while driving, the camera will also no longer bounce weirdly in this situation
[*]General settings options now display the correct tooltip when hovering over them
[*]Fixed display of route duration while creating/editing a route
[*]Fixed texture of the selection square during bus and character customization. Instead of a white block it should now look nicer
[*]The ramp button in the action menu should now be correctly highlighted
[*]Moved the NPC (Non-Player-Character) and NPV (Non-Player-Vehicles) spawn rate settings to the company/session settings as they could crash the game when changed in the main menu
[*]Removed thousands separator from the resolution in the settings menu (1.080 is now 1080)
[/list]

[b]Buses[/b]
[list]
[b]Bus fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bendy bus joints. This prevents them from breaking apart when a player walks through them
[*]Fixed some seat adjustment issues - Before you had to use Numpad keys and not every keyboard has those, now it’s the Arrow keys (This can now also be rebound in the controls settings)
[*]Fixed wraps on the interior monitors for the MAN Lion’s City CNG Articulated
[*]Fixed floating stickers in a Scania bus
[*]Fixed wiper animation of MAN Lions City 18C
[*]Fixed bus LED displays showing the name of the next station twice
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[b]Bus improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved steering curve on MAN Lion’s City A26 and Setra S 418 LE Business
[*]Added texture to the eCitaro interior lights
[*]Increase the intensity of lights in the eCitaro, and improved their performance
[/list]
[/list]

[b]General Visual Fixes/Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Tweaked “Very High” Shadow Quality a bit, so it looks better than “High”
[*]Reduced stretching floors of rooms behind some windows
[*]Fixed Material of certain rocks when viewed from a distance
[*]Tweaked the quality of some trees when viewed from a distance 
[*]Improved visual quality of some far away assets and fixed some that were broken
[/list]

[b]Map Fixes[/b]
[list]
[b]Angel Shores[/b]
[list]
[*]Tutorial no longer gets blocked if the player closes the door before Mira unboards
[*]GPS in Mission #2 now always leads to the correct paint shop
[*]Made the first voice-over in Mission #2 conditional to prevent it from playing, even when the mission was already partially done
[*]Reworked UI Tutorial of mission #7 “Source and Sink” to make it more stable
[*]During the mission “Hop Off”, Mira can no longer get stuck in mid-air if the player doesn’t complete the mission goals as intended
[*]Made the Transit Station glass panels transparent again
[*]Fixed flying grass at multiple places
[*]Moved foliage into the correct sub-tile, which should result in less pop-in
[*]Removed some of the landscape holes where people got stuck
[*]Fixed player being stuck on an NPC bus de-spawning in depot
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[b]Seaside Valley[/b]
[list]
[*]Detection for the first objective of the mission “Take off” now works correctly
[/list]
[/list]

[b]General Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved memory usage of missions
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b] [i]We are aware of a bug concerning the backup of steering wheel settings. This bug causes the deletion of such settings and hinders you from creating new bindings. Should this come up, you will observe that the binding menu simply closes causing the game to be unresponsive to any inputs. This situation can be solved by deleting the "InputPreset" file in the following location:[/i]
C:\Users\[UserName]\AppData\Local\BusSimulator21\Saved\SaveGames\
[i]We will release a hotfix to tackle this issue soon.[/i]

notes.title: Bus Simulator 21 - Now available!
notes.content:
More buses, more brands and freedom like never before! Today, we are happy to announce that with Bus Simulator 21 the most extensive bus driving experience in the history of the popular game series is ready for departure!

https://youtu.be/KVBGRHePQwI

With Bus Simulator 21 the latest part of the popular simulation game series is now available on the digital download stores as well as a disk version in numerous retail stores around the world. Players can look forward not only to the most extensive vehicle fleet, but also to numerous new and improved features and the freest gaming experience in series history to date!

[b]Numerous brands and bus models![/b]

With 30 officially licensed buses by 10 world-famous brands such as Mercedes-Benz, Volvo, Scania, BYD, Alexander Dennis, Blue Bird, Grande West, Setra, IVECO BUS and MAN bus enthusiasts can choose from an unprecedented variety of bus models in Bus Simulator 21 - including city buses, articulated buses and, for the first time, also e-buses and a double-decker! 

[b]Two maps, multiplayer and an even freer open world approach![/b]

Compared to its predecessor, Bus Simulator 21 offers two huge, lively maps: The North American-inspired city “Angel Shores”, and the European based city “Seaside Valley” known from its predecessor Bus Simulator 18 including the areas of the official map expansion. Both maps are offering an even freer open-world approach that invites players to explore their surroundings: For example, to pay a visit to the bus dealer to look at new models or to go on a merry search for carefully hidden easter eggs - be it alone or in cooperative multiplayer mode with up to three other players.

Another innovation is the floating day and night cycle, including dynamic weather. In addition, players will - for the first time - be able to access convenience comfort functions such as fast travel to all important points on the map, an option to fast forward the time to any point, and take-over the buses of their teammates or AI colleagues at any time they want. True to the motto “Less time in menus and more time on the road”, players are free to choose whether they want to use these options via the map menu or within the game world directly.

[b]Enhanced management features![/b]

If bus driving isn’t enough for you, you can also look forward to numerous whole new and improved management functions which, if desired, provide even more depth to the game. In Bus Simulator 21 you can not only create your own routes freely, but for the first time also use more in-depth micromanagement in order to optimize the income of your local transport company: examples are setting up detailed timetables including peak times, efficient route planning that takes the number of passengers at specific day or night times into account and more.

[b]Exciting challenges and random events![/b]

During the bus rides, players can expect plenty of variety: In addition to the huge selection of different bus models with their unique driving behavior, challenging traffic situations - such as narrow streets, oncoming traffic, serpentines, bus stations, night journeys, construction sites, cross-country journeys, potholes, traffic jams, traffic obstacles and speed bumps - ensure that bus drivers will have ample opportunity to prove their driving skills in different situations. Random events such as a litter left behind in the bus, special requests from passengers, fare dodgers, loud music, and blocked bus stops should of course also not go unnoticed by the driver.

[b]Numerous customizing options for buses and player characters![/b]

To ensure that the bus company presents an individual corporate identity to the player’s wishes, Bus Simulator 21 offers extensive options to customize the appearance of buses and bus drivers. Buses can not only be designed freely in terms of color but can also be decorated with a huge selection of stickers, complete paintworks and advertisements. Meanwhile, the new character editor comes up with more than 15,000 design combinations with which the appearance of the bus drivers can be adjusted according to the player’s preferences in terms of physique, clothing, skin color, hairstyle, accessories, etc.

[b]Angel Shores Insider Skin Pack DLC as a free download during release week![/b]

Players wishing for even more options to customize their bus fleet, can look forward to a very special gift during the release week of Bus Simulator 21: From September 07 until September 13, 2021 the Angel Shores Insider Skin Pack DLC with 10 additional skins will be included for free when buying the game here on Steam!

[b]Extended Version comes with exciting bonus content![/b]

The Bus Simulator 21 - Extended Edition, which is available as a digital download version only, also contains an exciting package of tempting bonus content: The MAN Bus Pack including a brand-new MAN Lion's City 12 city bus as well as three additional MAN interiors to adapt the interiors of the MAN buses!

Regardless of which offer the players will choose: The game’s additional content packages will also be available as separate DLCs on the digital stores so that every player can mix and match their unique dream content package.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/976590/Bus_Simulator_21/

notes.title: Bus Simulator 21 provides you with more customization options than ever before!
notes.content:
Fellow Bus Drivers! Customization is important. We know that, you know that, everyone knows that. That's why we've greatly improved your options in Bus Simulator 21, allowing you to make things look exactly how you want them to - and that applies to both your character and your buses.

Today, we'll give you just a small insight into our customization tools while you can discover them all for yourself on September 7, 2021!

[b]Choose your style![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/e80a6d9057a52c77512f1e1485d0df44eca3fd0f.jpg[/img]

Right at the start of Bus Simulator 21, you can create your very own character. What body type do you want to have? How should your head look like? Which skin tone will your character have? Which hairstyle do you prefer? Will you have facial hair... or simply wear a mask? Wait, what will your hair color even look like? It's your choice.

In addition, you can of course also customize your clothing style. Choose your favorite top, pants, shoes and accessories - and pick the right color or material to dress up yourself for the next shift! All in all, there are more than 15,000 possible design combinations.

By the way: You can edit your character at any time in the main menu of the game.

[b]Welcome to Paint Paradise![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/e709c4f5a926da3bdbe2d7bb92a2ffbf3bceccf0.jpg[/img]

Even though Paint Paradise sounds like the perfect place for a vacation, it sadly isn't. However, it's still awesome! This is the paint shop at which you can freely design the appearance of all of your buses.
Choose your colors, put on some wraps, add new decals - or stick the bus on with advertisements. Of course, you can also change the interior of your bus! While a few of the designs are available right from the start, you can unlock even more by fulfilling side missions which will pop up on the map from time to time. Gotta catch 'em all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/08577ddbc52ace74320d561a0b6e46890433e185.jpg[/img]

No worries, you don't have to drive to Paint Paradise every time you want to change the appearance of your bus. This option is also available in the Garage tab in the menu.

[b]From the Dealership to the Depot[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/aa6f5801bd97b6a20c63606b67b33d73ea6b12b1.jpg[/img]

The B&D Bus Dealership is your reliable partner when it comes to purchasing new buses. Here, all kinds of buses are available so that you can add them to your fleet. To acquire a bus, simply head to the terminal at the main entrance of the dealership and select an unlocked bus!

After you've selected your bus, you are now able to test drive them around the dealership. We've put together a cone parkour and other obstacles for you to practice - and if the bus is to your liking, leave the dealership together with your bus and confirm your purchase. This will, obviously, only work if you have enough money for that... so work hard, buy hard, play hard!

The Depot is the heart of your bus company. Here, all of your buses are parked in the garage when they're currently not in use - and at the terminal, you can take a look at your collection and select them for a drive. Steve, your beloved co-worker who's always connected to you via intercom, is managing your fleet. If you've finished your work for today, you can drive into the depot and let him take over the rest. What's even cooler is the fact that you can even see your AI drivers come out at the start and head to at the end of their shift!

The dealership, the paint shop, the depots... all of these have multiple locations all around Angel Shores and Seaside Valley. And, that's nice, you can fast travel to them at any time.

[b]Bus Simulator 21 releases on September 7, 2021![/b]

That's it for today! You can try out all these features for yourself when Bus Simulator 21 releases on September 7, 2021 Do not forget to wishlist the game here on Steam. Go, grab your friends and set up a group already - we're not far away!

notes.title: Bus Simulator 21 - Management
notes.content:
Fellow Bus Drivers! In Bus Simulator 21, we'll give you more control over your company than ever before. With several new management features and greatly improved mechanisms from Bus Simulator 18, it's now your time to shine as the leadership figure of your future bus empire!

We'll give you just a small insight into our set of features while you can discover them all on September 7, 2021!

[b]A new, fresh map[/b]
We've greatly improved our map in comparison to Bus Simulator 18. It has now a lot more simplistic layout while offering the same great overview as before. Our clean design makes it possible to see every street, every bus station and every district immediately - and even your AI bus drivers driving their routes. In addition, our dealerships, garages and paintshops are also clearly marked on the map. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/d86cde62fab8531fa55ee698ac258a34ccb20c03.png[/img]

By the way: With such a huge map, you can of course fast-travel to every single place!

[b]Demand System[/b]
Every route is highly customizable and offers a lot of depth for all our expert players. We're providing you a completely new management feature with the demand system: Every station has a different amount of passengers entering and leaving your bus - and to have an optimal operation ongoing, you should balance your route for full capacity. Should you achieve perfection, this will improve your payday as well. Should you need more information for your optimization efforts, look at the menues for peaktimes and speed limits as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/c0389aca2f09720fbf79a9abf519be93a373facd.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/208639efa474fb23a007432523433fe036b1aef8.jpg[/img]

By the way: Of course, you can change route names, route number (three digits!), route type and the platform as well.

[b]Timetables[/b]
Speaking of demand: Different stations have a different demand at different times of a day. For example, suburban areas have their peak time in the morning as lots of people want to get to work in downtown - while in the afternoon, many of them want to get back home, therefore causing higher demand in downtown. In our new timetable - also a new management feature! - we'll give you the opportunity to add full time buses and peak time buses while also changing the time a bus needs to reach their next destination. You see lots of buses waiting at a red light, causing a delay? Maybe you should adjust their timetable so that these hurdles are already included precautionary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/e5094d68dd416f8bada598a364bb6fa6df21c135.png[/img]

[b]Paydays[/b]
Hard work needs to be rewarded. We agree! After reaching a new career level, a payday is getting triggered which is calculated by a number of factors. How much income did your different routes generate - based on demand satisfaction, peak time adjustments and bus stop level? How high were the upkeep costs? How expensive are wages, how many penalties did you collect for bad driving, how high are the maintenance costs? You can find all these details in our statistics menu if you want to go more in-depth!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/a5c544d2536b0b8ac10efa1619c4b62b413ad50d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/fdc2c61edadb3c3f8825c3b70d409c46d735dddc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/e5a01270968339f50fe39d7a584a5708ac26e203.png[/img]

[b]Continuous Driving[/b]
The employees of your company will drive all routes themselves - but of course, you can drive every bus yourself as well! I mean, after all, we're a Bus Simulator. Should you decide that you're rather in the mood to explore the world, you can just leave the bus and call for a colleague to take over the bus. After staying away for too long from the bus, this will be automatically done, by the way. You can of course also take over buses from your employees by fast-traveling to them via the map or simply entering them at a bus station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/61adca7b2083ae2f53c27939cbbea647c782aae6.jpg[/img]

[b]Bus Simulator 21 releases on September 7, 2021![/b]
That's it for today! You can try out all these features for yourself when Bus Simulator 21 releases on September 7, 2021

notes.title: Bus Simulator 21 to be launched on September 7, 2021
notes.content:
We are more than pleased to announce the continuation of our long-term, successful partnership with the popular German manufacturer Mercedes-Benz for the upcoming Bus Simulator 21. In addition to numerous bus models known from its predecessors, the game will also contain two brand new Mercedes-Benz eCitaro buses for the first time in the history of the series!

The official Bus Simulator 21 – Mercedes-Benz Trailer is available here:
https://youtu.be/8WzKbx1FDdE

[b]Bus Simulator 21[/b]
[list]
[*]Bus Simulator 21 will be released on September 07, 2021
[*]30 officially licensed buses of world-wide known brands – incl. city buses, articulated buses, e-buses and a double decker
[*]Contains numerous Mercedes-Benz buses of the Citaro and CapaCity series and, for the first time, also eCitaros!
[*]Includes two huge maps with a US and European setting respectively!
[*]A number of new, reworked and extended features
[*]Improved open world gameplay
[*]Co-op multiplayer mode
[/list]

In Bus Simulator 21, you get the opportunity to set up your own local transport company in the fictional US metropolis “Angel Shores”, as well as the European based city “Seaside Valley”, and prove your bus driving skills.

With an enormous number of officially licensed and lovingly recreated bus models, you can look forward to experiencing the most extensive part of the popular simulation game series in Bus Simulator 21. Thanks to the continuation of the successful partnership with the popular manufacturer Mercedes-Benz, you can now for the first time get behind the wheel of officially licensed e-buses of the eCitaro series!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40475603/f82d6363cf64f494e630d82c00834319bad0bfd8.jpg[/img]

In addition to a small, 2-doored, 12-meter-long, maneuverable Mercedes-Benz eCitaro e-bus with two axles, the game will also include a large three-door, 18-meter-long eCitaro G articulated bus equipped with three axles and plenty of space for numerous passengers - two real highlights for bus lovers! Next to this, you can hit the roads with a Citaro G, the agile Citaro K, an up-to-date version of the Citaro O 530, as well as a CapaCity and the extra-long CapaCity L articulated bus.

Just like its predecessor, Bus Simulator 21 will give you the opportunity to manage your bus company either alone as a single player or in a cooperative multiplayer mode together with friends. Thanks to the two huge maps and its improved and even freer open world approach as well as numerous new, revised and expanded features, you can look forward to the most extensive bus driving experience in the successful history of the popular game series!

We hope you are looking forward to it as much as we do. So, don’t miss to wishlist the game right now!
